disclaimer: Model simplificat pe baza legislatiei disponibile la 2026-10-20; nu inlocuieste un calcul de payroll sau consultanta fiscala. Rotunjirile oficiale nu sunt modelate.

steps: 1. employer_contribution_i = rate_i * max(0, min(B_i, band_to_i) - band_from_i), unde B_i = gross * base_factor_i (daca B_i < minimum_base_i atunci B_i = minimum_base_i; band_to null = infinit).
3. employee_contribution_i: aceeasi formula ca la pasul 1.
4. taxable_base = gross * taxable_income.gross_factor - sum(contributiile angajatului listate in subtract_employee_contributions).
5. Deductiile din taxable_income.deductions se evalueaza in ordine; taxable_income = max(0, taxable_base - sum(deductii)).

6. Pentru fiecare componenta din income_taxes (in ordine): x = valoarea variabilei 'input'; tax_gross = parts * brackets(x / parts) sau function(x); tax = max(0, tax_gross - sum(credits)) (daca refundable_credits = false).
7. net = gross - sum(contributii angajat) - sum(taxe) + sum(net_additions).
8. Invers (cost angajator -> net): employer_cost este strict crescator in gross, deci gross se gaseste prin bisectie pe [0, employer_cost], apoi se aplica pasii 3-7.
calculation_algorithm.brackets: Impozit marginal: sum(rate * (min(x, to) - from)) pentru toate treptele cu x > from; to null = infinit.
calculation_algorithm.function: FUNCTION = {input, segments[], min, max}. Se alege primul segment cu from <= x < to (to null = infinit); t = (x - offset) / scale (implicit offset 0, scale 1); daca round = 'floor'/'ceil' se rotunjeste t; y = c0 + c1*t + c2*t^2 (coeficientii lipsa = 0). Daca niciun segment nu se potriveste, y = 0. Apoi y se limiteaza la [min, max] daca sunt definite.

income_taxes.name: Dohodnina 2026 (annual scale, Pravilnik UL 104/2025)

assumptions: Gross = 12 equal monthly regular salaries; annual dohodnina computed on the annual base. Monthly akontacija uses the same scale and allowances divided by 12 (first bracket 810.12, general allowance 462.66/month), so for an equal monthly wage withholding equals the final annual tax (no refund/top-up).

Rules in force from 1 March 2026 annualised: OZP 39.36/month x 12 (actual calendar-2026 OZP is 2x37.17 + 10x39.36 = 467.94, 4.38 less) and minimum contribution base 1,521.62/month x 12 (1,436.95 applied Jan-Feb).

Employee contributions 23.10% (PIZ 15.5, ZZ 6.36, DO 1.0, zaposlovanje 0.14, starsevsko 0.10) and OZP all reduce the dohodnina base; employer 17.10% (PIZ 8.85, ZZ 6.56, PPD 0.53, zaposlovanje 0.06, starsevsko 0.10, DO 1.0). No contribution ceiling.

Minimum contribution base: if gross < 18,259.44/yr, employer contributions are computed on the minimum base, the employer additionally pays the employee's PIZ/ZZ/DO on the difference (encoded as a negative employer_reduction), and the employee pays only the 0.14% + 0.10% on the difference (per e-fascikel 2026 worked example). Treatment of the difference is a practitioner reading of ZPIZ-2 Art. 144 / ZPSV; impact is <1 EUR/yr on net at minimum wage.
